phase_prompt.label: Transformation into Spirit
phase_prompt.summary: The figure dissolves into crystalline light within a dim stone chamber.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic cinematic matte of a lone figure in ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian garb, standing in a dim stone chamber surrounded by swirling bio‑luminescent glyphs, as the figure begins to transform into a translucent spirit made of crystalline light, with intricate ancient symbols etched into robes and a staff of obsidian and crystal, grounded realism, tactile textures, industrial mysticism, cinematic depth of field
